title: Complete VOD conversion progress
brief: A discreet, truthful progress overlay on the lower edge of the player while a complete compatible VOD is prepared for hosts and guests.
placement: Inside the player, pinned to the lower video edge; it never becomes a separate page panel.
implementation_notes: Render percentage and ETA only from reported conversion values; the numeric values in measurable artboards are layout specimens, not product defaults.
Use the indeterminate preparation state until measurable progress exists, and explicitly say ETA is unavailable when it cannot be calculated.
Keep progressbar semantics, AA-contrast text, DOM reading order, narrow-screen stacking, and no nonessential motion.

artboards.title: Initial preparation
artboards.tradeoff: Uses a static indeterminate treatment and deliberately withholds percentage and ETA until conversion reports them.

artboards.title: Measured progress
artboards.tradeoff: Makes reported percentage and ETA immediately scannable without obscuring the player; shown values are layout specimens.

artboards.title: Measured progress without ETA
artboards.tradeoff: Preserves a reported percentage while explicitly declining to invent a remaining-time estimate.
